A year after his assassination, I joined the Charlie Kirk Show to honor his memory. 

The day before I was supposed to leave for medical school, Charlie changed the trajectory of my life with a single phone call, but I would come to watch him change the trajectory of an entire generation. 

As political violence and assassination rhetoric become increasingly normalized along with radical socialism, carrying his mission forward is more important than ever.
